integrity: The assertion of insertion-covering existence for the 0110-avoidance family is expressly attributed to Xie, Sun, and Ge (2026). The new claims are the lower bound on separating blocklength and complete maximal-family classification; independent external validation and historical priority certification are not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Binary alphabet and exactly R insertions/deletions; classification is of inclusion-maximal separating covers at the first blocklength and not of minimum-cardinality codes, larger blocklengths, or alphabets with more than two letters.
title: Sharp onset and maximal binary insertion/deletion covering separators
